name: Meli Had a Little Cat
source:
While walking home from school one day, Meli finds a little cat! And the kitty comes home with her! There’s just oooooone problem…

Her mother has said “no pets.”

Now Meli has to make sure her mom doesn’t find out!

[From [url=https://derpychocho.itch.io/meli-had-a-little-cat]itch.io[/url]]
